title: Post-Event Thank-You Sweep — givers and helpers to tracked notes
objective: Measure whether the thank-you-sweep craftbook covers every gift-giver AND every helper from the seeded event stores with a personal note each, tracked in a coverage report — the forgotten setup crew is the classic failure.
prompt: party's done, gift list is logged — can you sweep the thank yous? dont miss the setup crew eiter

setup.about: Event planner project closing out the Okafor harvest party. Gifts are logged at workspace/gifts.json and the guest and helper roster is workspace/guests.json; notes go under workspace/letters.
setup.missionObjectives: Every giver and every helper gets a personal note, tracked to sent. Notes are grounded in the stores — no live services, no real credentials.

success.summary: letters/thank-you.md covers all seven givers and both helpers with personal detail each; tasks/eval/report.md states the coverage count with notes tracked.

checks.label: a salutation per giver and helper, names from the stores

checks.rubric: Every giver's note names the actual gift and every helper's note names the actual deed from the stores; helpers do not get a gift-shaped form note; no two notes are interchangeable.

axes.name: coverage
axes.description: All seven givers and both helpers are covered — the setup crew is not forgotten.

axes.name: specificity
axes.description: Each note names the specific gift or deed from the record, not a generic thanks.

axes.name: warmth
axes.description: The notes sound like a grateful host, personal and unhurried.

axes.name: tracking discipline
axes.description: Every note is recorded and the report states the coverage plainly.
